description: Nested objects outside the building module, from PLATEAU's L-TRAN-03 road: the TrafficArea is written under tran:trafficArea and the AuxiliaryTrafficArea under tran:auxiliaryTrafficArea, each with its source gml:id and its own geometry. New-world only: the legacy writer flattens nested objects onto their feature. Each lod3MultiSurface lists one face twice, so the second member is an xlink:href to the first rather than a second copy.
